-- Inert source fixture: the .fixture.txt suffix keeps it out of VMB bundles.
local function set_warlock_donor_mesh_visibility(owner_unit, visible)
    for mesh_index = 0, Unit.num_meshes(owner_unit) - 1 do
        Unit.set_mesh_visibility(owner_unit, mesh_index, visible, "default")
    end
end

mod._prepare_warlock_death = function(owner_unit, source)
    set_warlock_donor_mesh_visibility(owner_unit, true)
end
